dedupe_keys.name: demonstrating immersive media delivery on the 5g xcast broadcast and multicast testing networks munich surrey turku

description: This paper presents eight demonstrators and one showcase developed in the 5G-Xcast project to validate multicast and broadcast enablers for 5G media delivery. Three existing testbeds, IRT in Munich (Germany), 5GIC in Surrey (UK) and TUAS in Turku (Finland), were developed into 5G broadcast and multicast testing networks that show a converged infrastructure with fixed and mobile access and terrestrial broadcast delivering immersive audio-visual content; the use cases fall into Media and Entertainment and Public Warning, and the paper reports key findings on technical impact for broadcasters, content providers and operators. Producer: 16 authors from the 5G-Xcast consortium; the arXiv abstract page shows submission on 1 March 2020 (16 pages, 22 figures) and links the IEEE Transactions on Broadcasting version. Coverage: three European test sites. Access: free PDF and HTML on arXiv. Licence and cost: free to read; licence arXiv non-exclusive distribution licence (the paper; no open reuse licence). Caveats: testbed results, not operational networks, and the numerical results were not read beyond the abstract. Simulation uses: the demonstrator set-ups give validation cases for broadcast and multicast capacity models and for public warning delivery. Related record: EBU TR 044 on 4G and 5G broadcast trials (case_study-ebu-tr-044-4g-5g-broadcast-trials).
